fusions.name: Journey's End
fusions.desc: Fires a sting that deals 16 damage to the first enemy it reaches. Its damage rises 8% for every 100 paces you have run since you last used it, up to 40%. Usable only on an enemy at or below 30% health.

fusions.name: Paddle Spray
fusions.desc: Flicks 3 droplets at once, spread apart, each dealing 2 water damage, with a 30% chance per hit to leave the target [Soaked] for 4 seconds.

fusions.name: Unruffled
fusions.desc: For 4 seconds, blows that reach you deal no damage and no condition can take hold of you. While it lasts, a swarm fights beside you, striking for 3 every 1.2 seconds.

fusions.name: Rolls Right Off
fusions.desc: When anything but fire hurts you, you gain a shield worth 15% of your maximum health for 4 seconds. Once every 15 seconds.
